findings.source_quote: We decided to go to a major league baseball game.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more natural Afrikaans rendering such as "'n Major League‑bonds‑basebalwedstryd" or simply "'n wedstryd van die Major League". Preserve HTML tags and spacing.
findings.translation_quote: Ons het besluit om na ’n grootliga-basebalwedstryd te gaan.

findings.source_quote: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the personal pronoun register consistent with the rest of the translation (which uses the informal "jy/julle"): e.g. "As jy om die naam van Christus bespot word, is jy gelukkig; want die Gees van heerlikheid en God rus op jou: aan hulle kant word Hy kwaad gepraat, maar aan jou kant is Hy verheerlik." Preserve verse punctuation and quotation marks.
findings.translation_quote: 1 Petrus 4:14 sê, “As u om die naam van Christus bespot word, is u gelukkig; want die gees van heerlikheid en God rus op u: aan hulle kant word Hy kwaad gepraat, maar aan u kant is Hy verheerlik.”

findings.location: Reference to The Martyr’s Mirror (book title)
findings.source_quote: I ordered a copy of The Martyr’s Mirror and was astounded when I read about these people who lived like the disciples.
findings.suggested_fix: Leaving the book title in English is acceptable for a proper title, but if a translation is preferred for Afrikaans readers consider: "Ek het ’n eksemplaar van The Martyr’s Mirror (Die Martelare‑Spieël) bestel..." — otherwise no change required. Preserve italics/HTML marking.
findings.translation_quote: Ek het ’n eksemplaar van The Martyr’s Mirror bestel en was verstom toe ek lees van hierdie mense wat soos die dissipels geleef het.
